description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 6625012692463 MULTIMETER: Line 0001 Qty 109 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0057 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The term of the contract/order will be one year or until the aggregate total of orders placed against the contract/order reach 350000.00. The estimated number of orders per year is 10. The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 16. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved sources are 55026 12211; 55026 260-6XLPM; 60741 60M. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
